title: 3D
summary: Quiet editorial 3D in the theme's colours: matte paper objects (sheets, a magazine, covers, prints, the blocks of a layout grid) on the kit's paper grounds under soft shadowless light, with printed pages drawn as small textures. Slow glides and pushes on the kit's curves; nothing spins fast, bounces or glows. Core Three.js only. Pass "field" for the ground (paper, stone, blush, ink, wine) or "clear": true for a transparent canvas over footage.
usage: {"piece": "three/paper-stack"} or {"background": {"piece": "three/light-table"}}. Files: library/themes/editorial/three/pieces/ (shared stage and textures: _scene.js).

items.name: Paper stack
items.description: Printed sheets glide in from alternate sides and settle into a stack seen three-quarter from above; the last is a cover page in the accent ground. Props: count, top (ground of the last sheet), field, clear.

items.name: Page turn
items.description: An open magazine seen from above: leaves turn from right to left one after another, bending as they lift, each showing a new printed spread. Props: turns, every (seconds between turns), field, clear.

items.name: Ribbon
items.description: A wine ribbon bookmark slides down over a printed page and its swallow-tailed end curls towards the camera, breathing slowly. Props: color, page (ground of the page behind, '' for none), field, clear.

items.name: Type blocks
items.description: A page layout as architecture: the blocks of a 12-column grid (headline, text columns, a tall picture block in the accent, caption, folios) rise from a sheet one after another while the camera drifts round. Props: accent, field, clear.

items.name: Cover carousel
items.description: Eight magazine covers (a Didone numeral, a rule, a tint of the footage, two cover lines) rise into a ring and turn slowly past the camera. Props: count, fields (cover grounds), marks (masthead text per cover), speed, field, clear.

items.name: Light table
items.description: Photographic prints (tints of the footage in paper borders) glide onto a table in a loose grid; one is picked out with a crimson marker dot and the camera pushes in on it. Props: cols, rows, pick (index, -1 for none), color, field, clear.
